prompt:
Create exactly ONE full-body animation mother drawing of Xiaoman for shot S28 frame F000. Output a single isolated girl on true transparent background, portrait composition, preferably 1024 by 1536, with every hair tuft, both empty hands, entire dress, both legs and both red sandals safely inside the frame. No extra panels, no labels, no skeleton lines, no ground/background, no second figure.

REFERENCE HIERARCHY, intentionally different roles:
1. First reference is the approved Xiaoman turnaround. It alone controls identity, apparent age, head/body proportion, face, bangs, twin low pigtails with red ties, rounded white Peter Pan collar, short puff sleeves, yellow dress with white polka dots, red STRAPPED sandals and original line/paint style. Do not reproduce its three-view layout.
2. Second reference controls consistent facial features only. Draw narrowed, light-sensitive eyes and a quiet closed relaxed mouth. She is already squinting, not surprised, not crying, not cheerfully smiling.
3. Third reference is a COMPLETE-BODY pose construction only. Follow its screen-left facing, planted stance, and the near-left shoulder-elbow-wrist chain. Correct its simplified geometric face/hair/clothing to match reference 1. Keep the torso and both legs complete; do not draw only an arm patch. At F000, the light has already been on about 0.3 seconds. Her empty hands have separated after making a dog shadow. Near physical LEFT upper arm points forward and down from the left sleeve, elbow bent in front outside her ribs, left forearm angles up-left, open hand is at upper-chest height below the eye line and has NOT reached the final shielding peak. Far physical RIGHT arm hangs relaxed slightly behind the torso, readable at its true sleeve root and down at her right side. Exactly two arms, exactly two anatomically connected hands. No hand emerges from the chest. She will subsequently raise only the left arm; do not draw that later peak in this first image.
4. Fourth reference supplies real established hand linework and digit anatomy; its upper-right drawing specifies this frame's left palm orientation. Every hand has five coherent fingers including one thumb. All grandmother hands, bangle, rods and her clothing in the lower panels are irrelevant to the output and must not appear. Do not copy the old S20 dog/rod pose.
5. Fifth reference is spatial context ONLY: the child is the smaller screen-left figure, grandma is screen-right, the transmitted bright sheet is to the child's left/front; both feet are planted in their existing positions. Do not draw the other figure, sheet, lamp, rod guides, floor, text or lighting. Do not copy this technical diagram's simplified style.

BODY/CONTACT: whole shoulder belongs inside the sleeve cap; elbow and wrist connect naturally with child-sized upper arm/forearm, palm and fingers proportionate to the head. Keep the far arm behind the torso where occluded, then visibly emerging from the right sleeve, never duplicating it over the chest. Forearm, palm and face do not intersect. Both feet have believable soles and weight support, with the far foot slightly back/up in perspective, not hovering or crossing. Match reference 1's child proportions rather than stretching the technical silhouette.

ART/LIGHT: clean consistent hand-drawn animation linework and soft restrained cel shading. Neutral intrinsic/albedo colors, natural skin, original yellow/white/red outfit. No scene-grade, golden oil-lamp wash, cold blue overlay, glare bloom, rim light, cast shadow, simulated sheet-light or baked lighting; scene lighting is applied once later. Transparent alpha around the complete figure. No puppet, stick, phone, fan, television, new accessory, text or watermark. This is a single newly drawn F000 mother, not a collage or a warped old arm.
